model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the sharpness composition over training steps for a configuration denoted as "23.9 M, Nanodo, C4" in the title. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6400, with numeric tick marks evenly spaced at intervals of 1600. The y-axis is labeled "Sharpness composition" and employs a logarithmic scale ranging from $10^{-3}$ to $10^{0}$, with major tick marks at every power of ten. Two solid lines without markers are displayed on the graph. A solid blue line begins slightly above $10^{0}$ at 0 training steps and remains relatively steady just below $10^{0}$ across the entire x-axis, ending near $10^{0}$ at 6400 steps. A solid orange line also begins slightly above $10^{0}$ at 0 steps but exhibits a sharp initial decline, dropping to approximately $10^{-2}$ near 400 steps. Following this initial drop, the orange line rises and fluctuates, reaching a prominent peak of approximately $9 \times 10^{-2}$ around 3600 steps, before gradually declining with minor fluctuations to finish at roughly $2 \times 10^{-2}$ at 6400 steps.
